phases.title: Environment Setup
achievements: Scaffolded monorepo structure with backend (FastAPI) and frontend (React + Vite).
Configured robust .gitignore to exclude build files, virtual environments, local database files, and environment secrets.
Generated .env.example configuration template.

phases.title: Kite Connect Integration (Read-Only)
achievements: Registered Kite Connect OAuth redirect callback handling flow (/api/auth/callback).
Restricted operations exclusively to read-only endpoints (holdings & mf_holdings). Zero write/order capability.
Designed encrypted storage for Kite access tokens at rest using Fernet symmetric encryption.
Integrated interactive 'Reconnect Zerodha' redirect interface on the frontend.

phases.title: Price & NAV Enrichment
achievements: Created live stock quote fetcher using jugaad-data (NSELive) with a 15-minute query cache and yfinance fallback.
Created daily AMFI NAV parsing service fetching direct daily file updates. Mapped scheme codes and ISINs to NAV values for complete mutual fund valuation.

phases.title: Manual Assets (Fixed Deposits & Gold)
achievements: Engineered manual asset SQLite models supporting type-specific attributes.
Built compound interest calculator (FD) supporting monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly compounding.
Built gold spot price calculation using global Gold Futures (GC=F) and USD/INR exchange rates (INR=X) converted to INR per gram.

phases.title: Portfolio Computation Engine
achievements: Aggregated net worth, total investments, and unrealized gains across all active holdings.
Implemented Newton-Raphson numerical solver and Bisection fallback inside Python to calculate exact holding-level XIRR.

phases.title: Daily Snapshot & History
achievements: Configured APScheduler daemon running background snapshot tasks at 11:30 PM daily.
Programmed intelligent fallback to copy forward previous day's holdings snapshots (with refreshed market pricing) if Kite disconnects.

phases.title: REST API Surface
achievements: Exposed modular, clean routes for auth, holdings, manual assets, and portfolio overview.

phases.title: Frontend Dashboard
achievements: Crafted single-page dark mode dashboard using glassmorphic UI cards.
Integrated interactive Recharts Area chart for Net-Worth trend history and Pie chart for Asset Allocations.
Coded interactive modal forms for adding/editing manual assets.

phases.title: App-Level Login (Defense in Depth)
achievements: Secured all backend routes using PyJWT session token check and Bcrypt hashed password credentials validation.

phases.title: Deployment Scaffolding
achievements: Configured servers to bind to local/Tailscale host interfaces.
Created start.sh launch script to execute backend and frontend concurrently.

phases.title: Validation & Testing
achievements: Verified clean Python package resolution and Uvicorn pre-load boot.
Successfully compiled React assets bundle into production chunks.

phases.title: Documentation
achievements: Authored private setup README.md with credential generation guidelines and Tailscale instructions.

future_feature_plan.title: AI Holding Analyzer
future_feature_plan.description: Integrate LLM model to fetch latest stock news, company filings, and provide qualitative insights on active holdings.

future_feature_plan.title: Automated PDF Reports
future_feature_plan.description: Generate monthly PDF summaries of net-worth growth, asset allocations, and top performing holdings, emailed to the owner.

future_feature_plan.title: Tax Liability Calculator
future_feature_plan.description: Calculate realized capital gains tax liabilities (LTCG / STCG) for Indian equity markets based on manual trade entry.
